version: Am J Gastroenterol 2017; 112:18–35; published online 20 December 2016
population: 來源未標示（原文為研究族群描述：in prospectively-studied populations without identifiable risk factors for liver disease）
page_or_table: PDF 第 5 頁，What are Truly Normal Liver Chemistry Tests? → Summary statements 第 1 條
quote: A true healthy normal ALT level in prospectively-studied populations without identifiable risk factors for liver disease ranges from 29-33 IU/L for males and 19-25 IU/L for females, and levels above this should be assessed by physicians.
note: 為什麼不進表：它描述的是前瞻研究族群（without identifiable risk factors for liver disease）裡的健康正常 ALT 值，屬 MODEL.md §1-1 的回述型 definition；另外原文的健康正常值本身寫成一個區間（男 29-33、女 19-25 IU/L），指的是上限落點的範圍、不是一段數值的上下界；照 lower／upper 存會被讀成「正常值介於 29 到 33」，挑端點則是我們換算（R1b 請指揮位講清楚是哪種語義無法承載）。身分是 Summary statement（不帶 strength／evidence 等級），不列於 Table 1 的 Recommendations（R1 裁決 2026-09-10）。數字留在 quote。快照是 ACG 自家 CDN 的 Guideline Summary PDF，不是期刊完整正文。同文件第 1 頁 Abstract 另有措辭不同的同義句（29 to 33 IU/l），不得與本句拼接。

org: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases
page_or_table: 官方 PDF 第 2 頁末段（該段無次級小標）
quote: A problem with all grading systems using the upper limit of normal as an index is that there is little consensus on what the ULN should be or how it should be calculated. Thus, the upper limit of normal of ALT in different testing laboratories can range from 19 to 77 U/L, and some laboratories use a different reference range for women than men. Actually, current automated systems for measuring ALT values yield very similar results and use of common reference limits is reasonable, particularly in multicenter trials.
note: 為什麼不進表：19 to 77 U/L 是各檢驗室 ALT 上限的散布範圍（原文：in different testing laboratories），不是族群參考區間；放進 lower／upper 會被讀成「正常值 19–77」。緊鄰前句 little consensus on what the ULN should be 與本句連續，延長 quote 一起收；後一句 Actually, current automated systems… yield very similar results 同段連續、在限定前句，也一併收進 quote（只收前兩句會斷章）。原文 some laboratories use a different reference range for women than men 講的是檢驗室的做法，不是本列的適用族群，population 寫來源未標示。

page_or_table: What is an AST test? 段
quote: AST (aspartate aminotransferase) is an enzyme, a protein that speeds up certain chemical reactions in your body. It is found mainly in your liver but also in your heart, muscles, and other tissues.
note: 這個數字量的是什麼：原文說 AST 血液檢驗量的是血中 AST 的量（quote_extra）；AST 是一種酵素，主要在肝臟，也在心臟、肌肉與其他組織（quote；主詞與代名詞在同一段連續原文內，R1b 兩席指出單收 It 那句撐不住指標歸屬）。definition 的本義（schema：來源對「這個數字量的是什麼」的定義敘述，不帶數值；血壓頁 MedlinePlus 列前例）。取代原本「Low levels of AST…」一列（R1 兩席：定性判讀句不屬 definition，刪）。
quote_extra: An AST blood test measures the amount of AST in your blood.

page_or_table: Is there anything else I need to know about an ALT blood test? 段
quote: Since ALT is mostly found in the liver, an ALT test checks more specifically for liver damage.
note: 這個數字量的是什麼：原文說 ALT 大多在肝臟，所以 ALT 檢查更專門針對肝臟損傷（原文：checks more specifically for liver damage；不譯作檢驗統計的「特異性」，R1b）。definition 的本義（同 AST 那列）。R1 兩席 Q5 交集缺口補列。
